dockerfile:
# loong64 self-built (wave3) - gitea CE substitute for commitgo/gitea-ee
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/alpine:3.24
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata git su-exec 2>/dev/null || (sed -i 's|dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org|mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn|g' /etc/apk/repositories && apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata git su-exec)
WORKDIR /app
COPY gitea /app/gitea
COPY public/assets /app/public/assets
COPY entrypoint.sh /app/entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /app/gitea /app/entrypoint.sh && addgroup -g 1000 git && adduser -D -u 1000 -G git git && mkdir -p /app/data /app/custom /data && chown -R git:git /app /data
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai GITEA_WORK_DIR=/app USER_UID=1000 USER_GID=1000
EXPOSE 3000
ENTRYPOINT ["/app/entrypoint.sh"]

files.entrypoint.sh:
#!/bin/sh
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
  for d in /app/data /app/custom /data; do [ -d "$d" ] && chown -R "${USER_UID:-1000}:${USER_GID:-1000}" "$d"; done
  exec su-exec "${USER_UID:-1000}:${USER_GID:-1000}" /app/gitea
fi
exec /app/gitea

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends zabbix-agent && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY entry.sh /entry.sh
RUN chmod +x /entry.sh
EXPOSE 10050
ENTRYPOINT ["/entry.sh"]
